title: Synchronous external calls in hot routes
summary: Flask routes synchronously call external APIs for data that could be cached or pre-fetched.
rationale: Synchronous fan-out couples user latency to remote service performance and repeats avoidable network work.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Cache stable external responses, batch calls, or move slow enrichment to async/background flows.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
